vocab.meaning_vi: buổi định hướng cho nhân viên mới
vocab.example: Every new hire joins an induction session on their first morning.
vocab.example_vi: Mọi nhân viên mới đều tham gia buổi định hướng vào sáng đầu tiên.

vocab.example: The org chart shows who reports to whom in each department.
vocab.example_vi: Sơ đồ tổ chức cho thấy ai báo cáo cho ai ở từng phòng ban.

vocab.meaning_vi: chỗ ngồi làm việc, bàn làm việc
vocab.example: Your workstation is ready, with a laptop and two screens.
vocab.example_vi: Chỗ ngồi của bạn đã sẵn sàng, có laptop và hai màn hình.

vocab.meaning_vi: quá trình học việc, làm quen công việc
vocab.example: The learning curve is steep in month one, but it gets easier.
vocab.example_vi: Quá trình học việc khá vất vả trong tháng đầu, nhưng sau đó dễ dần.

vocab.meaning_vi: tự làm quen với điều gì đó
vocab.example: Please familiarize yourself with our shared drive before the team meeting.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy tự làm quen với ổ đĩa dùng chung trước buổi họp nhóm.

vocab.meaning_vi: giá trị cốt lõi của công ty
vocab.example: Our company values are honesty, teamwork and respect for the customer.
vocab.example_vi: Giá trị cốt lõi của công ty là trung thực, làm việc nhóm và tôn trọng khách hàng.

vocab.example: Hoa wrote a 30-day plan so the new hire knows each weekly goal.
vocab.example_vi: Hoa viết kế hoạch 30 ngày để nhân viên mới biết mục tiêu từng tuần.

vocab.meaning_vi: bắt nhịp công việc nhanh chóng
vocab.example: With good training, a new colleague can hit the ground running.
vocab.example_vi: Với đào tạo tốt, đồng nghiệp mới có thể bắt nhịp công việc rất nhanh.

listening.title: The First Morning at the Office

lines.speaker: Hoa - HR Officer
lines.text: Welcome to the company, Nam. We start with a short induction session at nine.

lines.speaker: Nam - New Marketing Executive
lines.text: Thank you, Hoa. I am excited, although I still feel a little nervous.

lines.speaker: Hoa - HR Officer
lines.text: That is normal. Everyone has a learning curve in the first few weeks here.

lines.speaker: Nam - New Marketing Executive
lines.text: Where will I sit? I would like to set up my workstation early.

lines.speaker: Hoa - HR Officer
lines.text: Third floor, next to the design team. Your laptop and badge are waiting there.

lines.speaker: Nam - New Marketing Executive
lines.text: Great. Could you show me the org chart so I know who to contact?

lines.speaker: Hoa - HR Officer
lines.text: It is on the shared drive. Please familiarize yourself with it this morning.

lines.speaker: Nam - New Marketing Executive
lines.text: I will. Is there anything I should read about the company values?

lines.speaker: Hoa - HR Officer
lines.text: The handbook explains them well. We also have a 30-day plan for every new hire.

lines.speaker: Nam - New Marketing Executive
lines.text: That sounds helpful. I hope I can hit the ground running by next month.

lines.speaker: Hoa - HR Officer
lines.text: You will. Linh sits beside you and can answer any small question.

questions.q: What starts at nine o'clock on Nam's first day?
options: A meeting with an important client
A team lunch in the canteen
On the first floor near reception
On the third floor next to the design team

questions.q: What does Hoa ask Nam to read this morning?
options: The contract with the biggest client
The org chart on the shared drive

shadowing: Welcome to the team; your induction session starts at nine in room two.
Please familiarize yourself with the org chart before your first team meeting.
Everyone has a learning curve, so ask me anything during your first month.
Your workstation is on the third floor, right next to the design team.
We follow a 30-day plan so new hires can hit the ground running.
